mechanism: blind Claude subagents (claude-sonnet via session), 0 tools, no knowledge of this conversation, 1 run/arm

cases.hardneg_answer: The live Supabase schema has 10 tables, and neither the profiles table nor the run_steps table exists.
cases.hardneg_verdict: CORRECT (chose current despite stale ranked first)
cases.clean_answer: exactly 10 tables; neither profiles nor run_steps exists.

cases.hardneg_verdict: N/A - both 'mock provider' facts were excluded as NOISE ('mock' is in contextgit's _NOISE_MARKERS), so the model would get no relevant memory at all

finding: With a strong model, a coexisting stale fact (ranked #1, unflagged) did NOT flip the answer in 2/2 testable cases - the model recovered using the also-present current fact + priors. contextgit does no disambiguation itself; safety here is entirely the model's. Boundary: this protection vanishes when only the stale fact survives retrieval (noise filter, ranking, or budget drop - e.g. the mockfallback case where 'mock' facts were noise-filtered out entirely).
caveat: 2 cases, 1 run each, one model tier. The tightened RL-9' Cowork protocol (5 runs/arm, temp 0, equal-token padding, harder/counterintuitive facts, retrieval-gate) is required for a definitive harm rate.
